acreage.basis: 3,200-acre southeast Cheyenne expansion intent (5 sq mi) tripling Microsoft's Business Pkwy & Bison holdings.

totalPlannedMw.basis: Estimated expanded multi-campus scale under Black Hills Energy LPCS tariff.

power.cleanPowerAndTariffSummary: Black Hills Energy's LPCS tariff requires Microsoft to pay 100% of dedicated substations, transmission, and energy procurement to protect Wyoming residential ratepayers.
